<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>QuantumCareer - Discover Your Alternate Timeline Career</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Orbitron:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --primary: #6c63ff;
            --secondary: #4cc9f0;
            --dark: #0d1b2a;
            --light: #f8f9fa;
            --accent: #f72585;
            --gradient-start: #6c63ff;
            --gradient-end: #4cc9f0;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
            color: var(--dark);
            background-color: var(--light);
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        h1, h2, h3, h4 {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }

        .container {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 2rem;
        }

        /* Header Styles */
        header {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--dark) 0%, #1b263b 100%);
            color: white;
            padding: 1.5rem 0;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
        }

        .header-content {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .logo-icon {
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gradient-start), var(--gradient-end));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            color: transparent;
        }

        nav ul {
            display: flex;
            list-style: none;
            gap: 2rem;
        }

        nav a {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
        }

        nav a:hover {
            color: white;
        }

        nav a::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -5px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gradient-start), var(--gradient-end));
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        nav a:hover::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1b2a 0%, #1b263b 100%);
            color: white;
            padding: 6rem 0 4rem;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 3rem;
        }

        .hero-text {
            flex: 1;
            max-width: 600px;
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gradient-start), var(--secondary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            color: transparent;
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
            max-width: 500px;
        }

        .cta-button {
            display: inline-block;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gradient-start), var(--gradient-end));
            color: white;
            padding: 1rem 2.5rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.4);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .cta-button:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.6);
        }

        .cta-button:active {
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .hero-image {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .face-scan-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 20px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border: 1px solid rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.3);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .face-scan-placeholder {
            width: 90%;
            height: 90%;
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, #1b263b 0%, #415a77 100%);
            border-radius: 15px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-direction: column;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            text-align: center;
            padding: 1.5rem;
        }

        .scan-icon {
            font-size: 3rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gradient-start), var(--secondary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            color: transparent;
        }

        .scan-lines {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .scan-line {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--secondary), transparent);
            opacity: 0;
        }

        /* How It Works */
        .how-it-works {
            padding: 5rem 0;
            background: white;
        }

        .section-title {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gradient-start), var(--accent));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            color: transparent;
        }

        .section-subtitle {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto 4rem;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: #555;
        }

        .steps {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 2rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .step-card {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            width: 300px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .step-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.25);
        }

        .step-icon {
            height: 200px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gradient-start) 0%, var(--secondary) 100%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            color: white;
        }

        .step-content {
            padding: 1.8rem;
        }

        .step-number {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gradient-start), var(--secondary));
            border-radius: 50%;
            color: white;
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 36px;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .step-content h3 {
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            color: var(--dark);
        }

        /* Results Preview */
        .results-preview {
            padding: 5rem 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0f4f8 0%, #e2e8f0 100%);
        }

        .results-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .result-card {
            background: white;
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            width: 350px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .result-card:hover {
            transform: scale(1.03);
        }

        .career-image {
            height: 200px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gradient-start) 0%, var(--secondary) 100%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: white;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .career-content {
            padding: 1.8rem;
        }

        .career-title {
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--dark);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .career-title::before {
            content: '';
            display: inline-block;
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
        }

        .career-description {
            color: #555;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .confidence {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        .confidence-label {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--dark);
        }

        .confidence-bar {
            flex: 1;
            height: 10px;
            background: #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 5px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .confidence-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 5px;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gradient-start), var(--secondary));
        }

        /* Testimonials */
        .testimonials {
            padding: 5rem 0;
            background: white;
        }

        .testimonial-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
        }

        .testimonial-card {
            background: #f8fafc;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2rem;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
        }

        .testimonial-card::before {
            content: """;
            position: absolute;
            top: 20px;
            left: 20px;
            font-size: 5rem;
            color: rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.1);
            font-family: Georgia, serif;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .testimonial-content {
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
            font-style: italic;
            color: #4a5568;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .testimonial-author {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
        }

        .author-avatar {
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gradient-start) 0%, var(--secondary) 100%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: white;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .author-info h4 {
            color: var(--dark);
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .author-info p {
            color: #718096;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        /* CTA Section */
        .cta-section {
            padding: 5rem 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--dark) 0%, #1b263b 100%);
            color: white;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .cta-content {
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .cta-content h2 {
            font-size: 2.8rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gradient-start), var(--secondary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            color: transparent;
        }

        .cta-content p {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
        }

        .cta-buttons {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .secondary-button {
            background: transparent;
            color: white;
            border: 2px solid var(--secondary);
            padding: 1rem 2.5rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .secondary-button:hover {
            background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.1);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        /* Footer */
        footer {
            background: #0d1b2a;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            padding: 3rem 0 1.5rem;
        }

        .footer-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        .footer-column h3 {
            color: white;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
        }

        .footer-column ul {
            list-style: none;
        }

        .footer-column ul li {
            margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
        }

        .footer-column a {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .footer-column a:hover {
            color: var(--secondary);
        }

        .social-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        .social-icon {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;

      font-size: 12px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;

    }

    .btn-ghost:hover {

      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;

    .hero-stat-pill strong {
      color: #e5e7ff;

    /* Right: scanner card */
    .scanner-card {

      box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
      overflow: hidden;

    .scanner-glow {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0, rgba(127, 90, 240, 0.58), transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 90% 15%, rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.55), transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.28), transparent 55%);
      opacity: 0.45;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      pointer-events: none;

    .scanner-inner {

      height: 8px;

      background: #f97373;

      background: #facc15;

      background: #4ade80;

      align-items: center;

      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;

      border: 1px solid rgba(55, 65, 81, 0.8);

      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #22c55e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.9);

    .scanner-body {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(0, 0.95fr);
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: stretch;

    .face-frame-wrapper {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.34);
      padding: 10px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3), transparent 55%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .face-frame {
      flex: 1;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7), rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.95)),

      border: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.9);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-med), box-shadow var(--transition-med), transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .face-frame:hover {
      border-color: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.9);
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(55, 65, 81, 0.8),
        0 0 24px rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.6);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .frame-corner {
      position: absolute;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.9);
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .frame-corner.tl {
      top: 6px;
      left: 6px;
      border-right: 0;
      border-bottom: 0;
    }

    .frame-corner.tr {
      top: 6px;
      right: 6px;
      border-left: 0;
      border-bottom: 0;
    }

    .frame-corner.bl {
      bottom: 6px;
      left: 6px;
      border-right: 0;
      border-top: 0;
    }

    .frame-corner.br {
      bottom: 6px;
      right: 6px;
      border-left: 0;
      border-top: 0;
    }

    .scan-line {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      top: -30%;
      height: 32%;
      background: linear-gradient(
        to bottom,
        rgba(56, 189, 248, 0) 0%,
        rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5) 50%,
        rgba(56, 189, 248, 0) 100%
      );
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      transform: translateY(0);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .scan-line.is-scanning {
      animation: scan 1.9s linear infinite;
      opacity: 1;
    }

    @keyframes scan {
      0% {
        transform: translateY(-30%);
      }
      50% {
        transform: translateY(60%);
      }
      100% {
        transform: translateY(-30%);
      }
    }

    .face-placeholder {
      position: relative;

      height: auto;

      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.7);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.9);
      font-size: 11px;
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.4;

      box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(55, 65, 81, 0.7);
    }

    .face-placeholder::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 11%;
      border-radius: inherit;
      border: 1px solid rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.35);
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .face-placeholder-text {
      position: relative;
      padding: 0 12px;
    }

    .face-placeholder-text strong {
      color: #f9fafb;
      font-weight: 600;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .face-instruction {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .face-instruction span {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .chip {

      border-radius: 999px;

      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .chip strong {
      color: #e5e7ff;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Result column */
    .result-panel {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.34);
      padding: 10px 11px 10px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 90% 0, rgba(55, 65, 81, 0.7), transparent 60%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .result-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;

      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .result-header-main {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .result-label {
      font-variant: small-caps;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      font-size: 10px;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .result-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #e5e7ff;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .timeline-pill {
      padding: 3px 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.6);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .timeline-pill-badge {
      width: 9px;

      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.7);
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(129, 140, 248, 1);

    .result-summary {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);

    }

    .result-summary strong {

    }

      background: #22c55e;

      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 75%;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #22c55e, #facc15, #f97316);
    }

    .micro-copy {
      font-size: 9px;
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    /* Bottom sections */
    .section {
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }

    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;

      font-size: 12px;
      color: #e5e7ff;

      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.95);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96), rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.95));

      flex-direction: column;

      color: var(--muted);

      color: #e5e7ff;

      color: #e5e7ff;

    .faq-a {
      font-size: 11px;

    .cta-strip {
      border-radius: 18px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(55, 65, 81, 0.95);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 0 0, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35), transparent 55%),

    .cta-strip-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;

    }

    .cta-strip-text {
      max-width: 520px;
    }

    .cta-strip-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #f9fafb;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .cta-strip-subtitle {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .cta-strip-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .cta-badge-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      align-items: center;
    }

    .cta-badge {
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.7);
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .cta-badge-dot {

      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #22c55e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.9);

    footer {

      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;

      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-links {
      display: inline-flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .footer-link {
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
    }

    .footer-link::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      bottom: -2px;
      height: 1px;
      width: 0;
      background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.8);
      transition: width var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .footer-link:hover::after {
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      header {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

      nav {
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: space-between;
      }

      .hero-layout,
      .scanner-body,
      .feature-grid,
      .two-col {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }

      .hero-layout {
        margin-bottom: 40px;
      }

      .scanner-card {
        order: -1;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      main {
        padding: 18px 14px 40px;
      }

      .feature-grid {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }

      .cta-strip-top {

      }

      .hero-title {
        font-size: 28px;
      }

      .result-title {
        font-size: 13px;
      }

      header {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
      }
    }

    /* Hidden file input */
    #fileInput {
      display: none;

        confidenceText.textContent = pct + "%";
        confidenceFill.style.width = (60 + (career.confidence - 0.6) * 100) + "%";

      function simulateScan(callback) {
        scanLine.classList.add("is-scanning");
        faceFrame.classList.add("is-busy");

          scanLine.classList.remove("is-scanning");
          faceFrame.classList.remove("is-busy");

        fileInput.click();

        faceFrame.style.borderColor = "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.34)";

        faceFrame.style.borderColor = "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.34)";
        if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0]) {
          simulateScan(() => renderCareer(randomCareer()));
        }
      });

      fileInput.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
        if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
          simulateScan(() => renderCareer(randomCareer()));
        }
      });

      heroScanButton.addEventListener("click", triggerFileInput);

        simulateScan(() => renderCareer(randomCareer()));
      });

          "For now, imagine the timeline where you already joined. 🙂"
        );
      });

      // Initial random example
      renderCareer(randomCareer());
    })();

content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>AltCareer AI — Discover Your Parallel Life</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --primary: #7c3aed;
            --primary-light: #a78bfa;
            --primary-dark: #5b21b6;
            --accent: #06d6a0;
            --accent-dark: #05b384;
            --bg-dark: #0a0a1a;
            --bg-card: #12122a;
            --text: #e2e8f0;
            --text-muted: #94a3b8;
            --glow: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.4);
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text);
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        /* Animated background */
        .bg-animation {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .bg-orb {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(80px);
            opacity: 0.3;
            animation: float 20s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .bg-orb:nth-child(1) {
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            background: var(--primary);
            top: -200px;
            right: -100px;
            animation-delay: 0s;
        }

        .bg-orb:nth-child(2) {
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            background: #06d6a0;
            bottom: -100px;
            left: -100px;
            animation-delay: -7s;
        }

        .bg-orb:nth-child(3) {
            width: 300px;
            height: 300px;
            background: #f472b6;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            animation-delay: -14s;
        }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
            25% { transform: translate(50px, -50px) scale(1.1); }
            50% { transform: translate(-30px, 30px) scale(0.95); }
            75% { transform: translate(40px, 20px) scale(1.05); }
        }

        /* Grid overlay */
        .grid-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-image: 
                linear-gradient(rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Navigation */
        nav {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 1000;
            padding: 1rem 2rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            background: rgba(10, 10, 26, 0.7);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .nav-inner {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .logo {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-light), var(--accent));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .logo-icon {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1rem;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: white;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2rem;
            align-items: center;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover {
            color: var(--text);
        }

        .nav-cta {
            padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark));
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: white;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-cta:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px var(--glow);
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 8rem 2rem 4rem;
        }

        .hero-content {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 4rem;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .hero-text {
            max-width: 600px;
        }

        .badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
            background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.3);
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--primary-light);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .badge-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.8); }
        }

        h1 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 3.8rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        h1 .gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-light), var(--accent), #f472b6);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero-description {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.7;
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
        }

        .hero-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            padding: 1rem 2rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), #9333ea);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            color: white;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            text-decoration: none;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .btn-primary::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: -100%;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.15), transparent);
            transition: left 0.5s;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover::before {
            left: 100%;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px var(--glow);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            padding: 1rem 2rem;
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
            border-radius: 12px;
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary-light);
            background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1);
        }

        .social-proof {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .avatar-stack {
            display: flex;
        }

        .avatar {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px solid var(--bg-dark);
            margin-right: -10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .avatar:nth-child(1) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f472b6, #ec4899); }
        .avatar:nth-child(2) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #60a5fa, #3b82f6); }
        .avatar:nth-child(3) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #34d399, #10b981); }
        .avatar:nth-child(4) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fbbf24, #f59e0b); }
        .avatar:nth-child(5) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-light), var(--primary)); }

        .social-proof-text {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .social-proof-text strong {
            color: var(--text);
        }

        /* Hero Visual / Scanner */
        .hero-visual {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .scanner-container {
            width: 380px;
            height: 460px;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 24px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.2);
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 80px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1);
        }

        .scanner-header {
            padding: 1.25rem;
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1);
        }

        .scanner-header h3 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--primary-light);
        }

        .scanner-body {
            padding: 1.5rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .face-frame {
            width: 200px;
            height: 200px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .face-frame-ring {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 2px dashed rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.4);
            animation: spin 10s linear infinite;
        }

        .face-frame-ring:nth-child(2) {
            width: 85%;
            height: 85%;
            border-color: rgba(6, 214, 160, 0.3);
            animation-direction: reverse;
            animation-duration: 8s;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        .face-icon {
            font-size: 4rem;
            opacity: 0.6;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .scan-line {
            position: absolute;
            width: 160px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent), transparent);
            animation: scanMove 3s ease-in-out infinite;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent);
        }

        @keyframes scanMove {
            0%, 100% { top: 30%; }
            50% { top: 70%; }
        }

        .scanner-result {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 0.75rem;
            background: rgba(6, 214, 160, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(6, 214, 160, 0.2);
            border-radius: 12px;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .scanner-result-label {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .scanner-result-value {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text);
        }

        .scanner-confidence {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0 0.25rem;
        }

        .confidence-item {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .confidence-item span {
            display: block;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
        }

        .confidence-item strong {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--primary-light);
        }

        /* Floating elements around scanner */
        .float-card {
            position: absolute;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.15);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            animation: floatCard 6s ease-in-out infinite;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .float-card:nth-child(1) {
            top: 20px;
            right: -60px;
            animation-delay: 0s;
        }

        .float-card:nth-child(2) {
            bottom: 60px;
            left: -70px;
            animation-delay: -2s;
        }

        .float-card:nth-child(3) {
            bottom: -10px;
            right: -40px;
            animation-delay: -4s;
        }

        @keyframes floatCard {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-10px); }
        }

        /* Sections common */
        section {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            padding: 6rem 2rem;
        }

        .section-header {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto 4rem;
        }

        .section-header .badge {
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-header h2 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 2.8rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-header p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        /* How It Works */
        .steps-grid {
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 2rem;
        }

        .step-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.1);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
            text-align: center;
            transition: all 0.4s;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .step-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
        }

        .step-card:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .step-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            border-color: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.3);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }

        .step-number {
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.2), rgba(6, 214, 160, 0.1));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--primary-light);
            margin: 0 auto 1.5rem;
        }

        .step-card h3 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .step-card p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.6;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }

        /* Demo / Interactive Section */
        .demo-section {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.03), transparent);
        }

        .demo-container {
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.2);
            border-radius: 24px;
            padding: 3rem;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .demo-container::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.05), transparent, rgba(6, 214, 160, 0.05), transparent);
            animation: rotateBg 10s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes rotateBg {
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        .demo-inner {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .demo-icon {
            font-size: 3rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .demo-container h3 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        .demo-container > .demo-inner > p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            font-size: 1rem;
        }

        .upload-area {
            border: 2px dashed rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.3);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 2.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .upload-area:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary-light);
            background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.05);
        }

        .upload-area.dragover {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            background: rgba(6, 214, 160, 0.05);
        }

        .upload-icon {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }

        .upload-area h4 {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }

        .upload-area p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
        }

        #fileInput {
            display: none;
        }

        .camera-btn {
            padding: 1rem 2.5rem;

                    </div>
                    <div class="result-stat">
                        <div class="result-stat-value">${result.salary}</div>
                        <div class="result-stat-label">Alt-Salary</div>
                    </div>
                `;

                resultDisplay.classList.add('show');
                scanBtn.disabled = false;
                scanBtn.textContent = '🔮 Scan Another Timeline';
            }, 4200);
        });

        // FAQ accordion
        document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const item = btn.parentElement;
                const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
                document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));
                if (!isOpen) item.classList.add('open');
            });
        });

        // CTA form
        function handleCTA() {
            const email = document.getElementById('ctaEmail').value;
            if (email && email.includes('@')) {
                const btn = document.querySelector('.cta-email-form button');
                btn.textContent = '✓ You\'re on the list!';
                btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #059669)';
                document.getElementById('ctaEmail').value = '';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.textContent = 'Get Early Access';
                    btn.style.background = '';
                }, 3000);
            }
        }

        document.getElementById('ctaEmail').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') handleCTA();
        });

        // Scroll reveal
        const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' });

        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

        // Smooth scroll for nav links
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
            anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
                if (target) {
                    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            });
        });

        // Typing effect for scanner result
        const scannerResults = [
            "🎻 Concert Violinist",
            "🚀 Mars Colony Architect",
            "🍳 Michelin Star Chef",
            "🎬 Documentary Filmmaker",
            "🧪 Quantum Computing Pioneer",
            "🎸 Indie Rock Legend",
            "🧠 Neurosurgeon"
        ];

        let currentScannerResult = 0;
        const scannerResultEl = document.querySelector('.scanner-result-value');

        setInterval(() => {
            currentScannerResult = (currentScannerResult + 1) % scannerResults.length;
            scannerResultEl.style.opacity = '0';
            scannerResultEl.style.transform = 'translateY(10px)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                scannerResultEl.textContent = scannerResults[currentScannerResult];
                scannerResultEl.style.transition = 'all 0.4s ease';
                scannerResultEl.style.opacity = '1';
                scannerResultEl.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
            }, 300);
        }, 3000);
    </script>

    <script>

            {
                title: "🌀 Dream Cartographer",
                timeline: "Φ-6654",
                desc: "You map the collective unconscious, charting shared dream territories. Your atlas of 'The Common Nightmare Archipelago' is required reading in every psychology department across 12 galaxies.",
                traits: ["Fearless", "Analytical", "Lucid"]
            },
            {
                title: "🪐 Planet Namer",
                timeline: "Λ-3308",
                desc: "The Intergalactic Council hires you to give names to newly discovered planets. You named the famous vacation world 'Serendipia' and the prison planet 'Consequencia.'",
                traits: ["Creative", "Linguistic", "Cosmic"]
            },
            {
                title: "🦋 Metamorphosis Coach",
                timeline: "Θ-9021",
                desc: "You help people through their literal biological transformations. When humanity evolved to shapeshift, you became the most sought-after guide for first-time changes.",
                traits: ["Calm", "Trustworthy", "Adaptive"]
            },
            {
                title: "🎵 Silence Composer",
                timeline: "Β-4455",
                desc: "In a universe of constant noise, you craft perfect silences. Your 'Symphony of Absence' sold out the Void Arena. People pay millions for 30 seconds of your curated quiet.",
                traits: ["Minimalist", "Profound", "Still"]
            },
            {
                title: "🌌 Gravity Chef",
                timeline: "Γ-8876",
                desc: "You cook with gravity as your main ingredient. Dishes served at 0.3g taste completely different than at 2g. Your zero-G soufflé defies physics and expectations.",
                traits: ["Precise", "Experimental", "Fearless"]
            },
            {
                title: "📖 Parallel Self Therapist",
                timeline: "Α-1001",
                desc: "You specialize in counseling people who've met their alternate selves. Identity crises across timelines are your specialty. Your book 'Me, Myself, and My Other 10⁴⁷ Selves' is a bestseller.",
                traits: ["Compassionate", "Wise", "Multiversal"]
            },
            {
                title: "🔮 Probability Gardener",
                timeline: "Ζ-5520",
                desc: "You grow plants from seeds of possibility. Each flower blooms into a different reality. Your garden in the Schrödinger Valley is simultaneously the most beautiful and ugliest place in existence.",
                traits: ["Patient", "Quantum-Aware", "Nurturing"]
            },
            {
                title: "🎭 Identity Sculptor",
                timeline: "Ρ-7703",
                desc: "You carve new personalities from raw consciousness marble. When someone wants to reinvent themselves, they come to your studio. Your waiting list spans three lifetimes.",
                traits: ["Artistic", "Perceptive", "Transformative"]
            },
            {
                title: "🌊 Tide Philosopher",
                timeline: "Ν-2244",
                desc: "You sit by the ocean and translate wave patterns into life advice. Your tidal wisdom app has a 98% satisfaction rate. The moon sends you consulting fees.",
                traits: ["Contemplative", "Natural", "Wise"]
            },
            {
                title: "⚡ Lightning Librarian",
                timeline: "Μ-6699",
                desc: "You organize the Library of Storms, where every lightning bolt contains a story. Your dewey decimal system for electrical impulses revolutionized atmospheric literature.",
                traits: ["Fast", "Organized", "Electric"]
            },
            {
                title: "🧩 Paradox Mechanic",
                timeline: "Κ-3317",
                desc: "When timelines break, you fix them. Your toolkit includes temporal wrenches and causal glue. You once repaired a grandfather paradox with nothing but duct tape and determination.",
                traits: ["Problem-Solver", "Brave", "Logical"]
            }
        ];

        let cameraStream = null;
        let isScanning = false;

        async function startCamera() {
            if (cameraStream) return;
            
            try {
                const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ 
                    video: { facingMode: 'user', width: 640, height: 480 } 
                });
                cameraStream = stream;
                const video = document.getElementById('video');
                video.srcObject = stream;
                video.style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('placeholder').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('viewport').classList.add('has-video');
                document.getElementById('scanBtn').disabled = false;
                showToast('✨ Camera activated — you look great across all timelines!');
            } catch (err) {
                showToast('📷 Camera access needed to scan your timeline');
                // Enable scan anyway for demo
                document.getElementById('scanBtn').disabled = false;
                document.getElementById('placeholder').innerHTML = '<span class="icon">🎭</span><p>Camera optional — click to try again<br><small style="opacity:0.5">or just hit scan below</small></p>';
            }
        }

        function startScan() {
            if (isScanning) return;
            isScanning = true;

            const container = document.getElementById('scannerContainer');
            const btn = document.getElementById('scanBtn');
            const resultCard = document.getElementById('resultCard');

            resultCard.classList.remove('show');
            container.classList.add('scanning');
            btn.classList.add('loading');
            btn.disabled = true;

            // Fun scanning messages
            const messages = [
                'Scanning facial topology...',
                'Querying parallel timelines...',
                'Matching quantum signatures...',
                'Decoding alternate life patterns...',
                'Resolving timeline paradoxes...',
                'Connecting to your alt-self...'
            ];

            let msgIndex = 0;
            const msgInterval = setInterval(() => {
                if (msgIndex < messages.length) {
                    showToast('🔮 ' + messages[msgIndex]);
                    msgIndex++;
                }
            }, 600);

            // Simulate scan
            setTimeout(() => {
                clearInterval(msgInterval);
                container.classList.remove('scanning');
                btn.classList.remove('loading');
                btn.disabled = false;
                isScanning = false;

                // Pick random career
                const career = careers[Math.floor(Math.random() * careers.length)];
                showResult(career);
            }, 3500);
        }

        function showResult(career) {
            document.getElementById('resultCareer').textContent = career.title;
            document.getElementById('resultTimeline').textContent = career.timeline;
            document.getElementById('resultDesc').textContent = career.desc;

            const traitsContainer = document.getElementById('resultTraits');
            traitsContainer.innerHTML = '';
            career.traits.forEach(trait => {
                const el = document.createElement('span');
                el.className = 'trait';
                el.textContent = trait;
                traitsContainer.appendChild(el);
            });

            const resultCard = document.getElementById('resultCard');
            resultCard.classList.remove('show');
            void resultCard.offsetWidth; // trigger reflow
            resultCard.classList.add('show');

            resultCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        }

        function resetScan() {
            document.getElementById('resultCard').classList.remove('show');
            document.getElementById('scanner').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        function shareResult() {
            const career = document.getElementById('resultCareer').textContent;
            const timeline = document.getElementById('resultTimeline').textContent;
            const text = `🌀 I just discovered my alternate career!\n\nIn timeline ${timeline}, I'm a ${career}.\n\nFind YOUR parallel universe career at AltYou.ai`;

            if (navigator.share) {
                navigator.share({ title: 'My AltYou Result', text });
            } else {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
                    showToast('📋 Result copied to clipboard!');
                });
            }
        }

        function showToast(message) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            toast.textContent = message;
            toast.classList.add('show');
            setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2500);
        }

        // Smooth scroll for anchor links
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
            anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
                if (target) target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>AltCareer AI — Discover Your Parallel Path</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  :root {
    --bg-primary: #07060b;
    --bg-secondary: #0f0d18;
    --purple: #8b5cf6;
    --pink: #ec4899;
    --cyan: #06b6d4;
    --blue: #3b82f6;
    --text-primary: #f1f0f5;
    --text-secondary: #9892a6;
    --glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    overflow-x: hidden;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  /* ── Canvas Background ── */
  #particleCanvas {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    z-index: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ── Navigation ── */
  nav {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    padding: 1rem 2rem;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    background: rgba(7,6,11,0.7);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  }

  .logo {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .logo-icon {
    width: 32px; height: 32px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink));
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; align-items: center; }
  .nav-links a {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

  .btn-nav {
    padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink));
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: white;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.3s;
  }
  .btn-nav:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.4);
  }

  /* ── Hero Section ── */
  .hero {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 8rem 2rem 4rem;
  }

  .badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 1rem 0.4rem 0.5rem;
    background: var(--glass);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 100px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease;
  }

  .badge-dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px;
    background: #22c55e;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: pulse-dot 2s infinite;
  }

  @keyframes pulse-dot {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,0.4); }
    50% { opacity: 0.8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(34,197,94,0); }
  }

  h1 {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.05;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.1s both;
  }

  .gradient-text {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c084fc, #e879f9, #f472b6, #fb923c);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
  }

  .hero-sub {
    font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    max-width: 600px;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.2s both;
  }

  .hero-cta {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.3s both;
  }

  .btn-primary {
    padding: 0.9rem 2.2rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--pink));
    border: none;
    border-radius: 12px;
    color: white;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .btn-primary::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--purple));
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
  .btn-primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(139,92,246,0.5);
  }
  .btn-primary span { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

  .btn-secondary {
    padding: 0.9rem 2.2rem;
    background: var(--glass);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  .btn-secondary:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  .hero-stats {
    display: flex;
    gap: 3rem;
    margin-top: 4rem;
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease 0.4s both;
  }

  .stat { text-align: center; }
  .stat-num {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cyan), var(--blue));
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
  }
  .stat-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 0.2rem; }

  @keyframes fadeInUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  /* ── How It Works ── */
  .section {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    padding: 6rem 2rem;
  }

  .section-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 4rem;
  }

  .section-label {
    font-size: 0.8rem;

class Particle {
  constructor() {
    this.reset();
  }
  reset() {
    this.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
    this.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
    this.size = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
    this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3;
    this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3;
    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1;
    this.hue = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 260 : 330;

  update() {
    this.x += this.speedX;
    this.y += this.speedY;

    if (this.x < 0 || this.x > canvas.width || this.y < 0 || this.y > canvas.height) this.reset();

  }

        ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);

        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(animateParticles);
}

let cameraStream = null;
let hasImage = false;

function startCamera() {
  navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'user', width: 400, height: 300 } })
    .then(stream => {
      cameraStream = stream;
      const video = document.getElementById('videoElement');
      video.srcObject = stream;
      document.getElementById('uploadArea').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('cameraOverlay').classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('faceGuide').classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('scanBtn').disabled = false;
      hasImage = true;
    })
    .catch(() => {
      alert('Camera access denied. Please upload a photo instead.');
    });
}

// File upload
document.getElementById('dropZone').addEventListener('click', () => document.getElementById('fileInput').click());
document.getElementById('fileInput').addEventListener('change', function(e) {
  if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(ev) {
      document.getElementById('uploadArea').style.display = 'none';
      const preview = document.getElementById('previewImg');
      preview.src = ev.target.result;
      preview.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('scanBtn').disabled = false;
      hasImage = true;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(e.target.files[0]);
  }
});

const dropZone = document.getElementById('dropZone');

dropZone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => { dropZone.style.borderColor = ''; });
dropZone.addEventListener('drop', e => {

  dropZone.style.borderColor = '';

});

function startScan() {

  btn.disabled = true;
  progress.classList.add('active');
  if (document.getElementById('cameraOverlay').classList.contains('active')) {

    "Mapping facial geometry...",
    "Analyzing micro-expressions...",

    "Matching career archetypes...",
    "Calculating confidence scores...",
    "Resolving quantum uncertainties...",
    "Finalizing your alternate career..."
  ];

  let step = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    step++;
    const pct = Math.min(100, (step / 10) * 100);
    bar.style.width = pct + '%';
    if (step <= statuses.length) status.textContent = statuses[step - 1];
    if (step >= 10) {
      clearInterval(interval);
      setTimeout(showResults, 400);
    }
  }, 500);
}

function showResults() {
  const career = careers[Math.floor(Math.random() * careers.length)];
  const timeline = timelineNames[Math.floor(Math.random() * timelineNames.length)];
  const tlNum = Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000000) + 1000000;
  const conf = (Math.random() * 15 + 82).toFixed(1);

  document.getElementById('scanProgress').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('scanBtn').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('cameraOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('previewImg').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('scanLine').classList.remove('active');

  document.getElementById('resultTimeline').textContent = `Timeline #${tlNum.toLocaleString()} — ${timeline}`;
  document.getElementById('resultCareer').textContent = career.emoji + ' ' + career.title;
  document.getElementById('resultConfidence').textContent = conf + '% Match';
  document.getElementById('resultDesc').textContent = career.desc;
  document.getElementById('resultTraits').innerHTML = career.traits.map(t => `<span class="trait">${t}</span>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('alt1Emoji').textContent = career.alt[0].emoji;
  document.getElementById('alt1Title').textContent = career.alt[0].title;
  document.getElementById('alt1Pct').textContent = career.alt[0].pct + ' match';
  document.getElementById('alt2Emoji').textContent = career.alt[1].emoji;
  document.getElementById('alt2Title').textContent = career.alt[1].title;
  document.getElementById('alt2Pct').textContent = career.alt[1].pct + ' match';

  document.getElementById('resultsContainer').classList.add('active');
}

function resetScanner() {
  // Stop camera
  if (cameraStream) {
    cameraStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
    cameraStream = null;
  }
  document.getElementById('resultsContainer').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('scanBtn').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('scanBtn').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('uploadArea').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('cameraOverlay').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('previewImg').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('scanLine').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('faceGuide').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('scanProgress').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = '0%';
  document.getElementById('fileInput').value = '';
  hasImage = false;
}

function submitEmail() {
  const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value;
  if (email && email.includes('@')) {
    const btn = document.querySelector('.email-form button');
    btn.textContent = '✓ Joined!';
    btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #22c55e, #16a34a)';
    setTimeout(() => {
      btn.textContent = 'Join Waitlist';
      btn.style.background = '';
      document.getElementById('emailInput').value = '';
    }, 3000);
  }
}
</script>
