content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>FacePath AI — Your Alternate Career Awaits</title>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;700&display=swap');

        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        :root {
            --primary: #7c3aed;
            --primary-light: #a78bfa;
            --accent: #06d6a0;
            --accent2: #ff6b6b;
            --bg-dark: #0a0a0f;
            --bg-card: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            --text: #e2e8f0;
            --text-muted: #94a3b8;
        }

        html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Animated background */
        .bg-grid {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(124,58,237,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .bg-glow {
            position: fixed;
            width: 600px; height: 600px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            filter: blur(150px);
            opacity: 0.15;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .bg-glow-1 { top: -200px; left: -100px; background: var(--primary); }
        .bg-glow-2 { bottom: -200px; right: -100px; background: var(--accent); }
        .bg-glow-3 { top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); background: var(--accent2); opacity: 0.06; width: 800px; height: 800px; }

        /* Nav */
        nav {
            position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            padding: 1rem 2rem;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            background: rgba(10,10,15,0.7);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }

        .logo {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-light), var(--accent));
            -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .logo-icon {
            width: 32px; height: 32px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1rem;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: white;
        }

        nav a {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }
        nav a:hover { color: var(--text); }

        .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; align-items: center; }

        .btn {
            padding: 0.65rem 1.5rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            border: none;
            font-family: inherit;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), #9333ea);
            color: white;
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(124,58,237,0.3);
        }
        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(124,58,237,0.5);
        }

        .btn-large {
            padding: 1rem 2.5rem;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            border-radius: 14px;
        }

        .btn-ghost {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            color: var(--text);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
        }
        .btn-ghost:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        /* Hero */
        .hero {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 8rem 2rem 4rem;
        }

        .badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            background: rgba(124,58,237,0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.3);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--primary-light);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease;
        }

        .badge-dot {
            width: 8px; height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            animation: pulse 2s infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1.5); }
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.1s both;
        }

        .hero h1 .gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-light), var(--accent), var(--accent2));
            -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-size: 200% 200%;
            animation: gradientShift 4s ease infinite;
        }

        @keyframes gradientShift {
            0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
            50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            max-width: 560px;
            line-height: 1.7;
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.2s both;
        }

        .hero-buttons {
            display: flex; gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center;
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease 0.3s both;
        }

        @keyframes fadeUp {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        /* Scanner Visual */
        .scanner-container {
            margin-top: 4rem;
            position: relative;
            animation: fadeUp 1s ease 0.5s both;
        }

        .scanner {
            width: 280px; height: 280px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .scanner-ring {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.2);
            animation: rotate 10s linear infinite;
        }
        .scanner-ring:nth-child(1) { inset: 0; border-color: rgba(124,58,237,0.3); }
        .scanner-ring:nth-child(2) { inset: 20px; border-color: rgba(6,214,160,0.2); animation-direction: reverse; animation-duration: 8s; }
        .scanner-ring:nth-child(3) { inset: 40px; border-color: rgba(255,107,107,0.15); animation-duration: 12s; }

        .scanner-ring::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            width: 10px; height: 10px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            top: -5px; left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }
        .scanner-ring:nth-child(1)::before { background: var(--primary-light); box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--primary); }
        .scanner-ring:nth-child(2)::before { background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--accent); }
        .scanner-ring:nth-child(3)::before { background: var(--accent2); box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--accent2); }

        @keyframes rotate { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

        .scanner-face {
            width: 100px; height: 100px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.2), rgba(6,214,160,0.2));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            border: 2px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.3);
        }

        .scan-line {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent), transparent);
            top: 0;
            animation: scanMove 3s ease-in-out infinite;
            z-index: 3;
            border-radius: 50%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        @keyframes scanMove {
            0%, 100% { top: 10%; opacity: 0; }
            10% { opacity: 1; }
            90% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { top: 90%; }
        }

        .floating-cards {
            position: absolute;
            inset: -80px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .float-card {
            position: absolute;
            padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
            background: rgba(15,15,25,0.9);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            white-space: nowrap;
            animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .float-card:nth-child(1) { top: 10%; left: -120px; animation-delay: 0s; }
        .float-card:nth-child(2) { top: 70%; right: -130px; animation-delay: -2s; }
        .float-card:nth-child(3) { bottom: 5%; left: -100px; animation-delay: -4s; }
        .float-card:nth-child(4) { top: 20%; right: -110px; animation-delay: -1s; }

        .float-card .fc-emoji { margin-right: 0.4rem; }
        .float-card .fc-label { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.7rem; }
        .float-card .fc-value { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }

        @keyframes float {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-15px); }
        }

        /* Stats */
        .stats {
            position: relative; z-index: 1;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 4rem;
            padding: 4rem 2rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .stat { text-align: center; }
        .stat-number {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-light), var(--accent));
            -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }
        .stat-label { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 0.3rem; }

        /* How it works */
        .section {
            position: relative; z-index: 1;
            padding: 6rem 2rem;
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .section-label {
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--primary-light);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-title {
            text-align: center;
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .section-desc {
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            max-width: 500px;
            margin: 0 auto 4rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .steps {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
        }

        .step {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
            text-align: center;
            transition: all 0.4s;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .step::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.3), transparent, rgba(6,214,160,0.3));
            -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
            -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
            mask-composite: exclude;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.4s;
        }

        .step:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
        .step:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }

        .step-num {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 50px; height: 50px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.2), rgba(124,58,237,0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.3);
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--primary-light);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .step h3 {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
        }

        .step p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Results showcase */
        .results-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 1.5rem;
        }

        .result-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 2rem;
            transition: all 0.4s;
            cursor: default;
        }

        .result-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            border-color: rgba(124,58,237,0.3);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }

        .result-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .result-avatar {
            width: 48px; height: 48px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
        }

        .result-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; }
        .result-real { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; }

        .result-career {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }

        .result-desc {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .result-confidence {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
        }

        .confidence-bar {
            flex: 1;
            height: 4px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .confidence-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            transition: width 1.5s ease;
        }

        .confidence-label { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }

        /* Testimonials */
        .testimonials {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 1.5rem;
        }

        .testimonial {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 2rem;
        }

        .testimonial-stars {
            color: #fbbf24;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .testimonial-text {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .testimonial-author {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.8rem;
        }

        .testimonial-avatar {
            width: 40px; height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .testimonial-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; }
        .testimonial-role { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; }

        /* CTA */
        .cta {
            position: relative; z-index: 1;
            padding: 6rem 2rem;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .cta-box {
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 4rem 3rem;
            border-radius: 24px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.1), rgba(6,214,160,0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.2);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .cta-box::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%; left: -50%;
            width: 200%; height: 200%;
            background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent, rgba(124,58,237,0.1), transparent, rgba(6,214,160,0.1), transparent);
            animation: rotate 20s linear infinite;
        }

        .cta-box > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        .cta-box h2 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .cta-box p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
        }

        .cta-input-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            max-width: 420px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .cta-input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            font-family: inherit;
            outline: none;
            transition: border-color 0.3s;
        }

        .cta-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
        .cta-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); }

        /* Footer */
        footer {
            position: relative; z-index: 1;
            padding: 3rem 2rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .footer-content {
            max-width: 1100px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .footer-links { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; }
        .footer-links a {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }
        .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--text); }

        .footer-copy { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }

        /* Scroll animations */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(40px);
            transition: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

        // Scroll reveal
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' });

        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

        // Counter animation
        const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    const el = entry.target;
                    const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
                    let current = 0;
                    const increment = target / 60;
                    const timer = setInterval(() => {
                        current += increment;
                        if (current >= target) {
                            current = target;
                            clearInterval(timer);
                        }
                        el.textContent = Math.floor(current).toLocaleString() + (target === 99 ? '%' : '+');
                    }, 25);
                    counterObserver.unobserve(el);
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.5 });

        document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number').forEach(el => counterObserver.observe(el));

        // Modal
        function openModal() {
            document.getElementById('scanModal').classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById('scanStep1').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('scanResult').classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }

        function closeModal() {
            document.getElementById('scanModal').classList.remove('active');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.getElementById('scanStep1').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('scanResult').classList.remove('show');
            }, 300);
        }

        document.getElementById('scanModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === document.getElementById('scanModal')) closeModal();
        });

        // Scan simulation
        const careers = [
            { emoji: '🎭', title: 'Broadway Star', desc: 'Your facial symmetry suggests a natural stage presence. In Timeline 7742-C, you\'re headlining a sold-out musical on the West End.' },
            { emoji: '🌋', title: 'Volcanologist', desc: 'Your intense gaze and determined jawline map perfectly to someone who stares into molten lava for a living. Timeline 3391-A says yes.' },
            { emoji: '🧑‍🚀', title: 'Deep Space Navigator', desc: 'Your orbital bone structure is optimized for zero-gravity. You\'re captain of the USS Horizon in Timeline 2088-D.' },
            { emoji: '🏴‍☠️', title: 'Pirate Captain', desc: 'Your cheekbones were literally designed for a tricorn hat. In Timeline 1643-B, you rule the Caribbean with an iron fist and a parrot.' },
            { emoji: '🧀', title: 'Artisan Cheese Maker', desc: 'Your nose detected 47 invisible flavor notes during the scan. You\'re a fromage legend in Timeline 8812-F, French Alps.' },
            { emoji: '🧙', title: 'Wizard', desc: 'Your facial geometry contains patterns found in 0.001% of humans — the same ones historically associated with spellcasting. Obviously.' },
            { emoji: '🏄', title: 'Professional Surfer', desc: 'Your balance ratios and ear shape suggest you were born to ride waves. Timeline 5520-A: 11x world champion.' },
            { emoji: '🧑‍🍳', title: 'Michelin-Star Chef', desc: 'Your taste bud density is off the charts (we can tell from your lips). You run a 3-star restaurant in Timeline 4419-B, Tokyo.' },
            { emoji: '🎪', title: 'Circus Ringmaster', desc: 'Your face radiates an energy that commands attention. In Timeline 6677-E, you lead the greatest show in the multiverse.' },
            { emoji: '🦜', title: 'Wildlife Photographer', desc: 'Your eyes have a natural zoom capability (metaphorically). Timeline 9901-C: you\'ve photographed every species on Earth-2.' },
        ];

        function startScan() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('scanBtn');
            btn.textContent = '⏳ Scanning facial dimensions...';
            btn.disabled = true;

            const pulse = document.getElementById('scanPulse');
            pulse.style.display = 'block';

            const preview = document.querySelector('.scan-preview');
            preview.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent)';
            preview.style.borderStyle = 'solid';

            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.textContent = '🧬 Analyzing multiverse trajectories...';
            }, 1000);

            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.textContent = '🌌 Mapping timeline probabilities...';
            }, 2000);

            setTimeout(() => {
                const career = careers[Math.floor(Math.random() * careers.length)];

                document.getElementById('scanStep1').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('resultEmoji').textContent = career.emoji;
                document.getElementById('resultTitle').textContent = career.title;
                document.getElementById('resultDesc').textContent = career.desc;
                document.getElementById('scanResult').classList.add('show');

                btn.textContent = '🔍 Start Scanning';
                btn.disabled = false;
                pulse.style.display = 'none';
                preview.style.borderColor = 'rgba(124,58,237,0.4)';
                preview.style.borderStyle = 'dashed';
            }, 3200);
        }

        // Keyboard shortcut
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
        });
    </script>

</body>
</html>

<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    overflow-x: hidden;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  /* ── Ambient Background ── */
  .ambient-bg {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .ambient-bg .orb {
    position: absolute;
    border-radius: 50%;
    filter: blur(120px);
    opacity: 0.15;
    animation: orbFloat 20s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .ambient-bg .orb:nth-child(1) {
    width: 600px; height: 600px;
    background: var(--accent);
    top: -200px; left: -100px;
    animation-delay: 0s;
  }

  .ambient-bg .orb:nth-child(2) {
    width: 500px; height: 500px;
    background: #ec4899;
    bottom: -150px; right: -100px;
    animation-delay: -7s;
    animation-duration: 25s;
  }

  .ambient-bg .orb:nth-child(3) {
    width: 400px; height: 400px;
    background: #06b6d4;
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    animation-delay: -14s;
    animation-duration: 30s;
  }

  @keyframes orbFloat {
    0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
    25% { transform: translate(60px, -40px) scale(1.1); }
    50% { transform: translate(-30px, 60px) scale(0.95); }

  /* ── Grid Overlay ── */
  .grid-overlay {

  /* ── Sections ── */

    const faceIcon = document.getElementById('faceIcon');

    const progressBar = document.getElementById('scanProgressBar');
    const status = document.getElementById('scanStatus');
    const resultCard = document.getElementById('resultCard');

    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = '⏳ Scanning...';
    resultCard.classList.remove('visible');

    // Activate visual effects
    outline.classList.add('scanning');
    scanLine.classList.add('active');
    faceIcon.classList.add('scanning');
    cornerMarkers.classList.add('active');
    progress.classList.add('active');
    status.classList.add('active');

    const statuses = [
      'Initializing quantum sensors...',
      'Mapping facial topology...',
      'Detecting micro-expressions...',
      'Cross-referencing timeline database...',

      'Calculating probability matrix...',
      'Locating parallel timeline...',
      'Decoding alternate life path...',
      'Verifying timeline integrity...',

    let step = 0;

      if (step < totalSteps) {
        status.textContent = statuses[step];
        progressBar.style.width = ((step + 1) / totalSteps * 100) + '%';
        step++;
      }

      if (step >= totalSteps) {
        clearInterval(interval);

        setTimeout(() => {
          // Deactivate effects
          outline.classList.remove('scanning');
          scanLine.classList.remove('active');
          faceIcon.classList.remove('scanning');
          cornerMarkers.classList.remove('active');
          progress.classList.remove('active');
          status.classList.remove('active');

          career.traits.forEach(trait => {
            const span = document.createElement('span');
            span.className = 'trait';
            span.textContent = trait;
            traitsContainer.appendChild(span);
          });

          resultCard.classList.add('visible');
          btn.textContent = '⚡ Scan Complete';

          setTimeout(() => {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = '⚡ Initiate Timeline Scan';
            isScanning = false;
          }, 2000);
        }, 800);
      }
    }, 400);
  }

  function resetScan() {
    const resultCard = document.getElementById('resultCard');
    resultCard.classList.remove('visible');
    const progressBar = document.getElementById('scanProgressBar');
    progressBar.style.width = '0%';
    document.getElementById('scanStatus').textContent = 'Ready to scan';

  // ── Smooth nav bg on scroll ──

    } else {
      nav.style.background = 'rgba(10, 10, 15, 0.7)';
    }
  });
</script>

                    <!-- Change button (shown after image selected) -->
                    <button class="change-btn hidden" id="changeBtn">⟳ Change photo</button>

                    <!-- Scan options -->
                    <div class="scan-options">
                        <button class="opt-btn active" id="uploadOpt">📁 Upload</button>
                        <button class="opt-btn" id="webcamOpt">📷 Camera</button>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Webcam -->
                    <div class="webcam-wrapper" id="webcamWrapper">
                        <video id="webcamVideo" autoplay playsinline muted></video>
                        <button class="capture-btn" id="captureBtn">Capture Frame</button>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Hidden file input -->
                    <input type="file" id="fileInput" accept="image/*" />
                </div>

                <!-- Scan button -->
                <div class="scan-action">
                    <button class="btn" id="scanBtn" disabled>✦ Analyze My Face</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ── Result Section ── -->
    <section id="result">
        <div class="container reveal-on-scroll">
            <div class="section-label">✦ Your Parallel Self</div>
            <h2 class="section-title">Your <span class="text-gradient-alt">alternate career</span> awaits</h2>
            <p class="section-sub">
                Based on your facial blueprint, here’s what you were meant to be
                in another timeline.
            </p>

            <div class="result-card" id="resultCard">
                <div class="result-badge">✦ Timeline Probability 94.2%</div>
                <div class="result-title">In another life, you are a</div>
                <div class="result-career" id="resultCareer">—</div>
                <div class="result-desc" id="resultDesc">
                    Your facial architecture suggests natural inclinations toward
                    this path. The multiverse confirms it.
                </div>
                <div class="result-traits" id="resultTraits">
                    <span>✨ Visionary</span>
                    <span>🌀 Adaptive</span>
                    <span>⚡ Intuitive</span>
                </div>
                <div class="result-actions">
                    <button class="btn" id="scanAgainBtn">✦ Scan Again</button>
                    <button class="btn btn-outline" id="shareBtn">↗ Share This</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ── Footer ── -->
    <footer>
        <div class="container">
            © 2025 Timeline AI — Exploring every version of you.
        </div>
    </footer>

    <script>
        (function() {
            'use strict';

            // ── Career Data ──
            const CAREERS = [{
                title: 'Interstellar Architect',
                desc: 'You design habitats on exoplanets. Your sense of geometry and balance makes you a natural at creating livable ecosystems in zero-gravity environments.',
                traits: ['🌌 Visionary', '🪐 Spatial Genius', '✨ Futurist']
            }, {
                title: 'Neural Cartographer',
                desc: 'You map the pathways of the human mind. Your facial symmetry hints at an extraordinary ability to visualize complex neural networks.',
                traits: ['🧠 Deep Thinker', '🔬 Analyst', '🌀 Pattern Seeker']
            }, {
                title: 'Quantum Chef',
                desc: 'You manipulate flavor at the molecular level. Your instinct for combining unexpected elements creates culinary experiences that defy physics.',
                traits: ['🍣 Innovator', '⚛️ Alchemist', '🎨 Sensory Artist']
            }, {
                title: 'Chrono-Archaeologist',
                desc: 'You excavate lost timelines. Your patience and attention to detail allow you to piece together civilizations that never were.',
                traits: ['⏳ Patient', '🔍 Detective', '📜 Storyteller']
            }, {
                title: 'Bio-Symphonist',
                desc: 'You compose music from living organisms. Your empathetic nature lets you hear the songs that cells and ecosystems naturally create.',
                traits: ['🎵 Harmonious', '🌿 Empath', '🎼 Creator']
            }, {
                title: 'Void Navigator',
                desc: 'You pilot ships through dark matter currents. Your calm under pressure and spatial awareness make you a legend among deep-space pilots.',
                traits: ['🛸 Fearless', '🧭 Navigator', '🌠 Resilient']
            }, {
                title: 'Dream Curator',
                desc: 'You design collective dreamscapes for restful sleep. Your artistic sensibility and emotional intelligence craft worlds that heal.',
                traits: ['💭 Imaginative', '🕊️ Healer', '🎭 Empath']
            }, {
                title: 'Gravity Sculptor',
                desc: 'You shape environments by bending gravitational fields. Your boldness and creativity turn barren asteroids into works of art.',
                traits: ['💪 Bold', '🎨 Creative', '🌌 Visionary']
            }, {
                title: 'Echo Linguist',
                desc: 'You translate languages of extinct civilizations. Your patience and pattern recognition decode messages from the deep past.',
                traits: ['📖 Scholarly', '🔎 Meticulous', '🌍 Curious']
            }, {
                title: 'Solar Shepherd',
                desc: 'You manage energy harvest from stars. Your strategic mind and respect for natural cycles keep entire systems powered.',
                traits: ['☀️ Strategic', '♻️ Sustainable', '🌱 Nurturing']
            }];

            // ── DOM refs ──
            const faceZone = document.getElementById('faceZone');
            const fileInput = document.getElementById('fileInput');
            const browseBtn = document.getElementById('browseBtn');
            const changeBtn = document.getElementById('changeBtn');
            const facePreview = document.getElementById('facePreview');
            const defaultState = document.getElementById('defaultState');
            const scanBtn = document.getElementById('scanBtn');
            const scanOverlay = document.getElementById('scanOverlay');
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            const resultCard = document.getElementById('resultCard');
            const resultCareer = document.getElementById('resultCareer');
            const resultDesc = document.getElementById('resultDesc');
            const resultTraits = document.getElementById('resultTraits');
            const scanAgainBtn = document.getElementById('scanAgainBtn');
            const shareBtn = document.getElementById('shareBtn');
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');

            const uploadOpt = document.getElementById('uploadOpt');
            const webcamOpt = document.getElementById('webcamOpt');
            const webcamWrapper = document.getElementById('webcamWrapper');
            const webcamVideo = document.getElementById('webcamVideo');
            const captureBtn = document.getElementById('captureBtn');

            // ── State ──
            let currentImage = null; // blob/dataURL
            let isScanning = false;
            let webcamStream = null;
            let webcamActive = false;
            let selectedCareer = null;

            // ── Helpers ──
            function showToast(msg, duration = 4000) {
                toast.textContent = msg;
                toast.classList.add('show');
                clearTimeout(toast._hide);
                toast._hide = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), duration);
            }

            function getRandomCareer() {
                return CAREERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CAREERS.length)];
            }

            // ── File handling ──
            function handleFile(file) {
                if (!file) return;
                const validTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/gif', 'image/bmp'];
                if (!validTypes.includes(file.type)) {
                    showToast('Please upload an image file (JPEG, PNG, etc.)');
                    return;
                }
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = (e) => {
                    const dataUrl = e.target.result;
                    setImage(dataUrl);
                };
                reader.readAsDataURL(file);
            }

            function setImage(dataUrl) {
                currentImage = dataUrl;
                facePreview.src = dataUrl;
                facePreview.classList.remove('hidden');
                defaultState.classList.add('hidden');
                changeBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                faceZone.classList.add('has-image');
                scanBtn.disabled = false;
                // stop webcam if active
                if (webcamActive) stopWebcam();
            }

            function clearImage() {
                currentImage = null;
                facePreview.classList.add('hidden');
                defaultState.classList.remove('hidden');
                changeBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                faceZone.classList.remove('has-image');
                scanBtn.disabled = true;
                fileInput.value = '';
            }

            // ── Webcam ──
            async function startWebcam() {
                try {
                    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'user' } });
                    webcamStream = stream;
                    webcamVideo.srcObject = stream;
                    webcamWrapper.classList.add('active');
                    webcamActive = true;
                    // hide default state
                    defaultState.classList.add('hidden');
                    facePreview.classList.add('hidden');
                    changeBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                    faceZone.classList.remove('has-image');
                    scanBtn.disabled = true;
                    currentImage = null;
                } catch (err) {
                    showToast('Could not access camera. Please allow camera permission.');
                    webcamOpt.classList.remove('active');
                    uploadOpt.classList.add('active');
                }
            }

            function stopWebcam() {
                if (webcamStream) {
                    webcamStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
                    webcamStream = null;
                }
                webcamVideo.srcObject = null;
                webcamWrapper.classList.remove('active');
                webcamActive = false;
                // if no image, restore default
                if (!currentImage) {
                    defaultState.classList.remove('hidden');
                    facePreview.classList.add('hidden');
                    changeBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                    scanBtn.disabled = true;
                } else {
                    // show the image again
                    facePreview.classList.remove('hidden');
                    changeBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                    defaultState.classList.add('hidden');
                    scanBtn.disabled = false;
                }
            }

            function captureWebcam() {
                if (!webcamActive || !webcamVideo.videoWidth) {
                    showToast('Camera not ready');
                    return;
                }
                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = webcamVideo.videoWidth;
                canvas.height = webcamVideo.videoHeight;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.drawImage(webcamVideo, 0, 0);
                const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9);
                setImage(dataUrl);
                // webcam will be stopped by setImage -> stopWebcam
            }

            // ── Scan simulation ──
            function runScan() {
                if (isScanning) return;
                if (!currentImage) {
                    showToast('Please upload or capture your face first.');
                    return;
                }
                isScanning = true;
                scanBtn.disabled = true;
                scanOverlay.classList.add('active');
                resultCard.classList.remove('reveal');
                progressBar.style.width = '0%';

                let progress = 0;
                const interval = setInterval(() => {
                    progress += Math.random() * 14 + 4;
                    if (progress > 100) progress = 100;
                    progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
                    if (progress >= 100) {
                        clearInterval(interval);
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            finishScan();
                        }, 400);
                    }
                }, 280);
            }

            function finishScan() {
                isScanning = false;
                scanOverlay.classList.remove('active');
                scanBtn.disabled = false;

                // pick career
                selectedCareer = getRandomCareer();
                resultCareer.textContent = selectedCareer.title;
                resultDesc.textContent = selectedCareer.desc;
                resultTraits.innerHTML = selectedCareer.traits.map(t => `<span>${t}</span>`).join('');

                // reveal result
                setTimeout(() => {
                    resultCard.classList.add('reveal');
                    // scroll to result
                    document.getElementById('result').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                }, 300);

                // reset progress
                progressBar.style.width = '0%';
            }

            // ── Share ──
            function shareResult() {
                if (!selectedCareer) {
                    showToast('Scan your face first!');
                    return;
                }
                const text =
                    `✨ In another timeline, I'm a ${selectedCareer.title}! ✨\n${selectedCareer.desc}\n\nFind your alternate career at Timeline AI 🔮`;
                if (navigator.share) {
                    navigator.share({ title: 'My Alternate Career', text }).catch(() => {});
                } else {
                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
                        showToast('Copied to clipboard! Share with your friends.');
                    }).catch(() => {
                        showToast('Could not copy. Try again.');
                    });
                }
            }

            // ── File drop / drag ──
            faceZone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                faceZone.classList.add('dragover');
            });
            faceZone.addEventListener('dragleave', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                faceZone.classList.remove('dragover');
            });
            faceZone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                faceZone.classList.remove('dragover');
                const files = e.dataTransfer.files;
                if (files.length) handleFile(files[0]);
            });

            // ── Click to browse (only when not in webcam mode and default visible) ──
            faceZone.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                // ignore clicks on buttons, preview, etc.
                if (e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('.change-btn') || e.target.closest('.scan-options') ||
                    e.target.closest('.webcam-wrapper') || e.target.closest('#facePreview')) return;
                if (!webcamActive && defaultState.classList.contains('hidden') === false) {
                    fileInput.click();
                }
            });

            browseBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                fileInput.click();
            });

            fileInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                if (e.target.files.length) handleFile(e.target.files[0]);
            });

            changeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (webcamActive) {
                    stopWebcam();
                }
                fileInput.click();
            });

            // ── Scan options ──
            uploadOpt.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                uploadOpt.classList.add('active');
                webcamOpt.classList.remove('active');
                if (webcamActive) stopWebcam();
                // if no image, show default
                if (!currentImage) {
                    defaultState.classList.remove('hidden');
                    facePreview.classList.add('hidden');
                    changeBtn.classList.add('hidden');
                    scanBtn.disabled = true;
                } else {
                    defaultState.classList.add('hidden');
                    facePreview.classList.remove('hidden');
                    changeBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
                    scanBtn.disabled = false;
                }
            });

            webcamOpt.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                webcamOpt.classList.add('active');
                uploadOpt.classList.remove('active');
                if (!webcamActive) {
                    startWebcam();
                } else {
                    stopWebcam();
                    webcamOpt.classList.remove('active');
                    uploadOpt.classList.add('active');
                }
            });

            captureBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                captureWebcam();
            });

            // ── Scan button ──
            scanBtn.addEventListener('click', runScan);

            // ── Scan again ──
            scanAgainBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                resultCard.classList.remove('reveal');
                document.getElementById('scan').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                // optionally clear image
                // clearImage();
            });

            // ── Share ──
            shareBtn.addEventListener('click', shareResult);

            // ── Keyboard shortcut ──
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !scanBtn.disabled && !isScanning && currentImage) {
                    runScan();
                }
            });

            // ── Scroll reveals ──
            const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal-on-scroll');
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.15 });
            revealEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

            // ── Particles ──
            const canvas = document.getElementById('particles-canvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            let particles = [];
            let w, h;

            function resize() {
                w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            }
            window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
            resize();

            class Particle {
                constructor() { this.reset(); }
                reset() {
                    this.x = Math.random() * w;
                    this.y = Math.random() * h;
                    this.size = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
                    this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
                    this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
                    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1;
                    this.hue = Math.random() * 60 + 240; // purple-blue range
                }
                update() {
                    this.x += this.speedX;
                    this.y += this.speedY;
                    if (this.x < 0 || this.x > w) this.speedX *= -1;
                    if (this.y < 0 || this.y > h) this.speedY *= -1;
                }
                draw() {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${this.hue}, 70%, 70%, ${this.opacity})`;
                    ctx.fill();
                    // faint glow
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
                    ctx.shadowColor = `hsla(${this.hue}, 80%, 70%, 0.15)`;
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                }
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) particles.push(new Particle());

            function animateParticles() {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.update();
                    p.draw();
                });
                // draw connections
                for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
                    for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
                        const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
                        const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                        if (dist < 120) {
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                            ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(124, 58, 237, ${0.06 * (1 - dist/120)})`;
                            ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                    }
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(animateParticles);
            }
            animateParticles();

            // ── Resize handling for particles ──
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resize();
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.x = Math.min(p.x, w);
                    p.y = Math.min(p.y, h);
                });
            });

            // ── Init ──
            // Show initial result example (faded)
            setTimeout(() => {
                // just a gentle hint
            }, 100);

            console.log('✨ Timeline AI ready — scan your face to find your alternate career!');

            // ── Cleanup webcam on page unload ──
            window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
                if (webcamStream) {
                    webcamStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
                }
            });

        })();
    </script>

</body>
</html>

The procedure

Three quiet steps, no drama.

We don't predict your future. We read the face you already wear and match it against the 10,000 timelines our model has catalogued. The match is returned as a postcard, not a verdict.

01

Sit for the aperture

Forty seconds in front of your camera, in any light that feels honest. The model reads 218 facial landmarks — none of them identifying, none of them stored beyond the session.

02

Find the neighbouring life

Your geometry is compared to a catalogue of lives lived well: trades, crafts, vocations that match the set of your features. The nearest neighbour — not the most flattering — is chosen.

03

Receive the postcard

A single image, a date, a place, and a short note written in the second person. You may keep it private, share it, or ask for one more. We don't recommend asking for a third.

A sample dispatch

What arrives, exactly, in the envelope.

Below is a real reading, lightly redacted. The face in question belonged to a software engineer in Lisbon. The postcard arrived seven seconds after the aperture closed.

content:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="description" content="Elsewhere AI scans your face and reveals your most likely career in another timeline.">
  <title>Elsewhere AI — Meet your alternate career</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --ink: #10100f;
      --paper: #f4f0e6;
      --acid: #c9ff35;
      --blue: #3457ff;
      --peach: #ff967c;
      --white: #fffef8;
      --line: 2px solid var(--ink);
      --shadow: 7px 7px 0 var(--ink);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--ink);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 18% 0%, rgba(201,255,53,.25), transparent 25rem),
        var(--paper);
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    button, input { font: inherit; }
    button, a { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .announcement {
      min-height: 36px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-bottom: var(--line);
      background: var(--acid);
      font-size: .76rem;
      font-weight: 850;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      text-align: center;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    header {
      position: sticky;
      z-index: 20;
      top: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      min-height: 74px;
      padding: 12px clamp(18px, 4vw, 64px);
      border-bottom: var(--line);
      background: rgba(244,240,230,.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }

    .brand {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 950;
      letter-spacing: -.04em;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      position: relative;
      width: 30px;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border: 2px solid;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--blue);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .brand-mark::before,
    .brand-mark::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      border: 2px solid var(--ink);
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--acid);
    }

    .brand-mark::before {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      left: -4px;
      top: 6px;
    }

    .brand-mark::after {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      right: -3px;
      bottom: 4px;
      background: var(--peach);
    }

    nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: clamp(16px, 3vw, 36px);
      font-size: .8rem;
      font-weight: 850;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
    }

    nav a:not(.nav-cta):hover { text-decoration: underline 2px; }

    .nav-cta,
    .button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 9px;
      min-height: 46px;
      padding: 0 20px;
      border: var(--line);
      border-radius: 0;
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--ink);
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--blue);
      font-weight: 900;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .055em;
      transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, background .15s ease;
    }

    .button:hover,
    .nav-cta:hover {
      transform: translate(3px, 3px);
      box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--blue);
    }

    .button:focus-visible,
    a:focus-visible {
      outline: 4px solid var(--peach);
      outline-offset: 3px;
    }

    .button.acid {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--acid);
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink);
    }

    .button.light {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink);
    }

    .button.plain {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: transparent;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    main { overflow: hidden; }

    .hero {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.04fr) minmax(340px, .96fr);
      gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 90px);
      align-items: center;
      max-width: 1440px;
      min-height: calc(100vh - 110px);
      margin: auto;
      padding: clamp(48px, 8vw, 110px) clamp(20px, 5vw, 76px);
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-size: .74rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .eyebrow::before {
      content: "";
      width: 11px;
      height: 11px;
      border: 2px solid var(--ink);
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--peach);
      box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink);
    }

    h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }

    h1 {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-size: clamp(3.8rem, 8.6vw, 8.3rem);
      font-weight: 950;
      letter-spacing: -.085em;
      line-height: .83;
    }

    .tilt {
      display: inline-block;
      color: var(--blue);
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .hero-copy > p {
      max-width: 650px;
      margin-bottom: 30px;
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 1.8vw, 1.45rem);
      font-weight: 560;
      letter-spacing: -.02em;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .privacy-note {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      font-size: .76rem;
      font-weight: 780;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .shield {
      display: grid;
      width: 22px;
      height: 25px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 2px solid;
      border-radius: 10px 10px 14px 14px;
      background: var(--white);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .hero-art {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 590px;
    }

    .orbit-label {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 4;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border: var(--line);
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink);
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .label-a { top: 6%; right: 0; transform: rotate(4deg); }
    .label-b { bottom: 9%; left: -5%; transform: rotate(-5deg); }

    .portrait-card {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 5% 5% 4% 8%;
      border: 3px solid var(--ink);
      background: var(--blue);
      box-shadow: 12px 12px 0 var(--ink);
      transform: rotate(2.4deg);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .portrait-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 440px;
      height: 440px;
      top: -170px;
      right: -140px;
      border: 3px solid;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--acid);
    }

    .portrait-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 140px;
      height: 140px;
      left: -40px;
      bottom: -40px;
      border: 3px solid;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--peach);
    }

    .face {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      width: 58%;
      height: 70%;
      left: 21%;
      top: 16%;
      border: 3px solid var(--ink);
      border-radius: 48% 48% 40% 40% / 38% 38% 58% 58%;
      background: #f3b99c;
      box-shadow: inset 0 -26px rgba(255,150,124,.65);
    }

    .hair {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 3;
      width: 62%;
      height: 31%;
      left: 19%;
      top: 11%;
      border: 3px solid;
      border-radius: 55% 55% 26% 24%;
      background: var(--ink);
      transform: rotate(-3deg);
    }

    .hair::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 42%;
      height: 80%;
      right: -6%;
      top: 38%;
      border: 3px solid var(--ink);
      border-radius: 40%;
      background: var(--ink);
    }

    .eye {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 4;
      top: 48%;
      width: 12px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--ink);
    }

    .eye.left { left: 38%; }
    .eye.right { right: 38%; }

    .nose {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 4;
      left: 48%;
      top: 51%;
      width: 18px;
      height: 42px;
      border-right: 3px solid;
      border-bottom: 3px solid;
      transform: skew(-8deg);
    }

    .mouth {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 4;
      width: 54px;
      height: 18px;
      left: calc(50% - 27px);
      top: 67%;
      border-bottom: 4px solid;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .scan-box {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 6;
      inset: 20% 25% 18%;
      border: 2px solid var(--acid);
    }

    .scan-box::before,
    .scan-box::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: -20%;
      right: -20%;
      height: 1px;
      background: rgba(201,255,53,.45);
    }

    .scan-box::before { top: 33%; }
    .scan-box::after { top: 66%; }

    .scan-line {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 7;
      left: 15%;
      right: 15%;
      top: 25%;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--acid);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--acid);
      animation: scan 2.7s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes scan {
      0%, 100% { top: 23%; }
      50% { top: 78%; }
    }

    .career-ticket {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 8;
      right: -3%;
      bottom: 3%;
      width: min(270px, 63%);
      padding: 18px;
      border: 3px solid var(--ink);
      background: var(--acid);
      box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink);
      transform: rotate(-3deg);
    }

    .career-ticket span {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-size: .66rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .13em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .career-ticket strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
      line-height: .94;
      letter-spacing: -.055em;
    }

    .marquee {
      display: flex;
      border-block: var(--line);
      background: var(--ink);
      color: var(--white);
      overflow: hidden;
      transform: rotate(-1deg) scale(1.02);
    }

    .marquee-track {
      display: flex;
      flex: none;
      min-width: max-content;
      padding: 14px 0;
      animation: marquee 22s linear infinite;
      font-size: .8rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .marquee-track span::after {
      content: "✦";
      margin: 0 28px;
      color: var(--acid);
    }

    @keyframes marquee {
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    .section {
      padding: clamp(78px, 10vw, 140px) clamp(20px, 5vw, 76px);
    }

    .section-inner {
      max-width: 1300px;
      margin: auto;
    }

    .section-heading {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: end;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .section-heading h2 {
      max-width: 850px;
      margin-bottom: 0;
      font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 6.4rem);
      line-height: .89;
      letter-spacing: -.075em;
    }

    .section-heading p {
      max-width: 360px;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .scanner-section {
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .scanner-shell {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: .65fr 1.35fr;
      min-height: 600px;
      border: 3px solid;
      box-shadow: 12px 12px 0 var(--ink);
      background: var(--ink);
    }

    .scanner-sidebar {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: clamp(25px, 4vw, 52px);
      border-right: 3px solid var(--ink);
      background: var(--acid);
    }

    .step-number {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .scanner-sidebar h3 {
      max-width: 400px;
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4.5vw, 4.3rem);
      line-height: .9;
      letter-spacing: -.065em;
    }

    .scanner-sidebar p {
      max-width: 410px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .micro-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .micro-list li {
      display: flex;
      gap: 9px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .micro-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 2px solid;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .scanner-stage {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 600px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
        var(--blue);
      background-size: 36px 36px;
    }

    .viewfinder {
      position: relative;
      width: min(430px, 78%);
      aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      background: #18205e;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .viewfinder::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 4;
      inset: 10% 16%;
      border: 2px dashed rgba(201,255,53,.9);
      border-radius: 48% 48% 43% 43%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .viewfinder::after {
      content: "ALIGN FACE WITH GUIDE";
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 5;
      top: 13px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: .62rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      text-align: center;
    }

    video,
    .demo-face {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transform: scaleX(-1);
    }

    video { display: none; }

    .demo-face {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 48%, #f4b496 0 25%, transparent 26%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 25%, #161616 0 18%, transparent 19%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 73%, #252525 0 30%, transparent 31%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #fa8e73, #c9ff35);
      transform: none;
    }

    .demo-face::before {
      content: "DEMO SUBJECT / E-04";
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      bottom: 15px;
      color: var(--ink);
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border: 2px solid;
      background: var(--acid);
      font-size: .61rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .09em;
    }

    .live-scan-line {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 8;
      left: 5%;
      right: 5%;
      top: 8%;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--acid);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--acid);
    }

    .scanning .live-scan-line {
      display: block;
      animation: liveScan 1.15s linear infinite;
    }

    @keyframes liveScan {
      from { top: 8%; }
      to { top: 91%; }
    }

    .scan-controls {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 10;
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      left: 24px;
      right: 24px;
      bottom: 24px;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .scan-controls .button {
      min-width: 150px;
      font-size: .72rem;
    }

    .progress-wrap {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 12;
      left: 7%;
      right: 7%;
      bottom: 24px;
      padding: 14px;
      border: 2px solid;
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink);
    }

    .scanning .progress-wrap { display: block; }
    .scanning .scan-controls { display: none; }

    .progress-meta {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-size: .65rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .progress {
      height: 14px;
      border: 2px solid;
      background: var(--paper);
    }

    .progress-bar {
      width: 0;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--acid);
      transition: width .15s linear;
    }

    .result-panel {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 15;
      inset: 34px;
      display: none;
      padding: clamp(26px, 5vw, 62px);
      border: 3px solid;
      background: var(--acid);
      box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 var(--ink);
    }

    .result-panel.visible {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      animation: reveal .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
    }

    @keyframes reveal {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.92) rotate(-2deg); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    }

    .result-kicker {
      font-size: .7rem;
      font-weight: 950;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .result-panel h3 {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 16px 0;
      font-size: clamp(3.1rem, 7vw, 6.8rem);
      line-height: .82;
      letter-spacing: -.085em;
    }

    .result-copy {
      max-width: 650px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .result-data {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 26px 0;
    }

    .result-data span {
      padding: 7px 10px;
      border: 2px solid;
      background: var(--white);
      font-size: .69rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .result-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .how {
      background: var(--peach);
      border-top: var(--line);
      border-bottom: var(--line);
    }

    .steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      border: 3px solid;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .step {
      min-height: 330px;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 45px);
    }

    .step + .step { border-left: 3px solid; }

    .step-index {
      display: grid;
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      margin-bottom: 58px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 3px solid;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--acid);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 950;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink);
    }

    .step:nth-child(2) .step-index { background: var(--blue); color: white; }
    .step:nth-child(3) .step-index { background: var(--peach); }

    .step h3 {
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.5vw, 2.2rem);
      letter-spacing: -.045em;
    }

    .step p {
      margin-bottom: 0;
      font-weight: 570;
    }

    .quote-section {
      color: var(--white);
      background: var(--ink);
    }

    blockquote {
      max-width: 1120px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5.7vw, 5.5rem);
      font-weight: 850;
      letter-spacing: -.06em;
      line-height: .99;
      text-align: center;
    }

    blockquote em {
      color: var(--acid);

      .step + .step { border-left: 0; border-top: 3px solid; }

    }

    @media (max-width: 560px) {

    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
